verdict.rationale: Lago is API-first and can be driven without its UI: every API endpoint has a generated command, events are posted via curl, a Docker self-hosted deployment exists, and the repo includes a script that starts a matching Lago version with a disposable local organization. Together these show non-interactive, scriptable operation, but nothing documents a CI integration or a dedicated headless mode. missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline documentation (e.g. GitHub Actions or test-environment guides), clarity on the generated-command CLI tooling, independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Every endpoint in this reference has a generated command.
It starts the Lago version that matches this checkout, creates a disposable local organization, and prices three illustrative AI requests.
Docker is the easiest way to get started with the self-hosted version of Lago.
